name: REACTT
aliases: A Study of Tadalafil After Radical Prostatectomy
question: Does tadalafil started early after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy, daily or on demand, improve unassisted erectile function after the drug is stopped?

design.population: 423 men aged 68 or younger with localized prostate cancer (Gleason score 7 or lower) and normal preoperative erectile function who underwent bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy at 50 centers in nine European countries and Canada.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, double-dummy, placebo-controlled randomized trial

verdictNote: Unassisted recovery after washout did not improve; daily tadalafil improved drug-assisted function and penile length loss.
takeaway: In 423 men after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy, tadalafil 5 mg daily or 20 mg on demand for 9 months did not improve unassisted erectile function after a 6-week washout versus placebo (20.9%, 16.9%, 19.1%); daily tadalafil improved drug-assisted function and reduced penile length loss.

reports.label: Initial report
reports.citation: Montorsi F, Brock G, Stolzenburg JU, et al. "Effects of Tadalafil Treatment on Erectile Function Recovery Following Bilateral Nerve-sparing Radical Prostatectomy: A Randomised Placebo-controlled Study (REACTT)." *Eur Urol.* 2014;65(3):587-596. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2013.09.051
reports.followUp: 9-month double-blind treatment, 6-week washout, 3-month open-label treatment (13.5 months)

results.measure: IIEF-EF of 22 or higher after 6-week drug-free washout (month 10.5), tadalafil once daily versus placebo
results.note: Primary endpoint not met for either tadalafil arm.
results.locator: abstract (odds ratio, percentages); ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01026818 results record, primary outcome (denominators)

results.measure: IIEF-EF of 22 or higher after 6-week drug-free washout (month 10.5), tadalafil on demand versus placebo
results.locator: abstract (odds ratio, percentages); ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01026818 results record, primary outcome (denominators)

results.measure: IIEF-EF of 22 or higher at the end of 9-month double-blind treatment (month 9)
results.note: Odds ratio is once daily versus placebo; on demand versus placebo was 1.50 (95% CI 0.79-2.85; P=0.210).
results.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01026818 results record, secondary outcome 1 (analyses); abstract (P=0.016 for once daily only)

results.measure: Mean change in IIEF-EF score from baseline to month 9; once daily versus placebo
results.note: Least-squares mean difference; on demand versus placebo 1.59 (95% CI -0.41 to 3.60; P=0.118). Improvement exceeded the 4-point minimally important difference in both tadalafil arms.
results.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01026818 results record, secondary outcome 3; abstract (minimally important difference)

results.measure: Sexual Encounter Profile question 3 (successful intercourse) at month 9, treatment effect versus placebo
results.note: Significant for once daily only; the 23% minimally important difference was exceeded in the once-daily arm only.
results.locator: abstract

results.measure: Reduction in penile length loss at month 9, once daily versus placebo (least-squares mean)
results.note: Millimeters of length retained. Significant for once daily only.
results.locator: abstract

results.measure: IIEF-EF of 22 or higher after 3 months of open-label daily tadalafil in all arms (month 13.5)
results.note: Odds ratio is once daily versus placebo; on demand versus placebo 1.35 (95% CI 0.80-2.29; P=0.259).
results.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01026818 results record, secondary outcome 1 (month 13.5 and analyses)

relations.note: Sildenafil trials established on-demand PDE5 inhibitor efficacy in erectile dysfunction; REACTT tested tadalafil started after prostatectomy for unassisted recovery.
